title: studio: machine names and raw ids shown where a label exists — Explain access principal, permission-set list, nav editor items, Changes panel
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio on the showcase boot: Access → *Explain access* names the principal `TCbwecFamZ9PuTlsv5X5z1RsFFP0v4qO`; the Access list shows a new permission set as `technician`; the Interfaces nav editor shows `nav_item_2` and `repairs_repair_tick…`.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「以下「立卡」：每个"新建"入口先给 3–5 个常用预设或模板，再提供"高级"选项；所有地方以标签为主，机器名只作为次要信息。…」.

## What happens

Where a label exists, Studio shows the machine name or the raw id instead:
- *Explain access* result: the Principal line renders `decision.principal.userId` (and `onBehalfOf.userId`) as the raw id, although the user picker right above it shows name and email (`AccessExplainPanel`).
- Access pillar: a new permission set appears in the left list as `technician`, not its label "Technician".
- Interfaces nav editor: a new item is labelled `nav_item_2`; an existing object item shows its machine name truncated (`repairs_repair_tick…`) instead of the object's label while editing.
- The Changes panel lists items by machine name only (`repairs_repair_ticket` "New").

## Expected

Label first; the machine name as secondary text (smaller, monospace) where an author needs it; user ids resolved to a person.

## Related

objectstack-ai/objectui#11697 (closed) fixed the same family for the audit-log actor and composite values on record pages.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

One shared name display (`label` + optional `name`) for these lists and chips; resolve user ids through the lookup the Explain access user picker already uses.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *machine name or raw id shown to users instead of label explain access principal user id*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Related, not the same ask:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11697 (closed) — same family fixed for the audit-log actor and record-page composite values
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: machine name shown instead of label studio · explain access principal raw user id · permission set list name not label
